summary: P0/P1 fixes verified: Lead Outreach and Inbound sections load correctly with 3-tab layout (Info, Contacts, Comms) in detail dialogs. Add Contact dialog works properly with all required fields. Bug Report button with file upload UI works. File upload endpoint exists and returns 401 without auth as expected.

Lead Outreach section with Contacts tab.description: Lead Outreach section at /client-engagement/crm/outreach loads correctly. Detail dialog has 3 tabs: Info, Contacts, Comms. Contacts tab shows 'No contacts yet' message with Add button.

Lead Inbound section with Contacts tab.description: Lead Inbound section at /client-engagement/crm/inbound loads correctly. Detail dialog has 3 tabs: Info, Contacts, Comms.

Add Contact dialog in lead detail view.description: Clicking Add button in Contacts tab opens Add Contact dialog with fields: Name* (required), Email, Phone, WhatsApp, Role/Title, Primary contact checkbox, and Cancel/Add buttons.

File upload endpoint (POST /api/upload).description: Endpoint exists at /api/upload. Returns 401 'Not authenticated' when called without auth credentials, which is expected behavior. Supports images and videos.

Bug Report button with file upload UI.description: Bug Report button found at bottom of sidebar. Opens 'Report Issue' dialog with Type/Priority selects, Subject/Description fields, and file upload area showing 'Click to upload image or video' with max size info (10MB image, 50MB video).

critical_code_review_comments: LeadOutreachSection.js has proper Tabs implementation with Info, Contacts, Comms tabs
LeadInboundSection.js has matching tab structure for consistency
BugReportButton.js properly implements file upload with validation (10MB for images, 50MB for videos)
File upload endpoint at /api/upload validates file types (images/videos) and returns proper error responses
All components have appropriate data-testid attributes for testing
